about: Numbers behind the under-vocal policy of the 'dogal' version (key C). Shares are fractions of the voiced sung time (44.85 s), note mode.

tune_under_the_voice.what: the soft Old MacDonald tune of the existing builder (clarinet C5 C5 C5 G4 A4 A4 G4 in bars 0, 2, 6; repeated C5 on beats 2-3 of bar 5)

voice_against_tune.where: beats 1.5-2 (voice A4 over tune G4) and beats 2-3.2 (voice G4 under tune A4): the two lines swap the notes G and A in the same octave

tune_against_chords.note: share of the tune's own sounding time; clash = a semitone from a chord tone or a tritone from the root. In bars 2 and 6 the tune's three 'do' (C) sit a semitone above the third (B) of the dominant.

definition: one_semitone_from_a_sounding_note = share of the sung time during which a band / pad / tune note one semitone away in pitch class sounds (band: note-on .. note-off + 30 ms from the band model; pad: held through every beat of the vocal stretches).
